Villa for sale in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club - The Residences, Dubai Land

Provident Real Estate is proud to present this exceptional 5-bedroom standalone villa, set within the prestigious Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club community. Overlooking pristine polo fields, this residence epitomizes refined living, equestrian elegance, and exclusive resort-style comfort.

Property Highlights

5 Bedrooms | 6 Bathrooms
Plot Size: 6,532.82 sq. ft
Unobstructed Polo Field Views
Elegant Interiors with premium marble flooring
Private Pool with direct access to polo fields
2 Covered Parking Spaces + 2 Outdoor Spaces
Generous Storage Room
Fully Furnished & Fully Equipped

Community Features & Lifestyle

Professional Equestrian Stables & Polo Academy
2 Paddle Courts | 2 Tennis Courts
2 Swimming Pools | 2 Fully Equipped Gyms
Pilates Studio, Luxury Spa, & Wellness Centre
Golf Shooting Range & Archery Academy
Professional Football & Rugby Training Facilities
High-End Beauty Salon & Wellness Retreat
Multiple Licensed Restaurants & Elegant Lounges
Boutique Retail Outlets & Luxury Jewelry Stores
5-Star Resort Managed by Marriott Bonvoy

A Truly Unique Lifestyle

This is Dubai’s only residential community centered around a fully operational international polo club and 5-star resort. Residents enjoy direct access to world-class sporting facilities, seasonal polo tournaments, and an array of exclusive amenities that redefine luxury living.

Whether you’re an equestrian enthusiast, savvy investor, or a family seeking privacy and sophistication, Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club offers a perfect blend of luxury, tranquility, and active community living.
